title: What Textile Art Looms 2.0 Is
definition: Textile Art Looms 2.0: next-gen looms for textile art.
description:
Textile Art Looms 2.0: next-gen looms for textile art. This is Future Art, Design & Fashion at its most ambitious — digital looms research, loom logistics engineering and fiber libraries operations converging on a single goal: making loom hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Art, Design & Fashion will decide pattern software outcomes this century. Textile Art Looms 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working loom hulls, the larger digital looms vision stalls, and with it, the loom logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Textile Art Looms 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Textile Art Looms 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Textile Art Looms 2.0.

The road to Textile Art Looms 2.0 is already being paved. Projection mapping festivals (Lyon Fête des Lumières) turn cities into canvases. Mycelium leather (Bolt Threads Mylo, Ecovative) and lab leather reach products.

Generative art (Refik Anadol, Sougwen Chung) fills museums with AI-driven works. Together these programs form the digital looms foundation that Textile Art Looms 2.0 will build on — the loom logistics results, the fiber libraries methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Readiness Estimator: Textile Art Looms 2.0
definition: Estimates Textile Art Looms 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Textile Art Looms 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a loom hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Textile Art Looms 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Textile Art Looms 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 25152 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where digital looms monitoring, loom logistics redundancy, or fiber libraries maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Textile Art Looms 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Textile Art Looms 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Textile Art Looms 2.0 — next-gen looms for textile art.

Phase 1 — Prove (digital looms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (loom logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fiber libraries): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (pattern software): loom hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and art-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
